cards.art: Frog-headed god emerging from void
cards.lore: Created himself to avoid paying union dues to parents. The ultimate freelancer.
cards.name: ATUM (THE SOLIPSIST)
cards.power: Autogenesis: Player creates a new rule from thin air.

cards.art: Dark primordial ocean swallowing cards
cards.lore: Infinite dark water. The unscripted pre-show where nothing matters.
cards.name: NUN (THE SOUP)
cards.power: Reset Board: Flush all active cards. Return to the void.

cards.art: Wind god holding two wrestlers apart
cards.lore: Got the job of holding his kids apart. Literally the atmosphere in the room.
cards.name: SHU (THE AIRHEAD)
cards.power: Wall of Wind: Blocks all flying attacks. Separates tag teams.

cards.art: Lion-headed goddess spitting acid at a weapon card
cards.lore: Born from a god's sneeze. Moisture farming with extreme prejudice.
cards.name: TEFNUT (THE SPITTER)
cards.power: Corrosive Spit: Destroys one Equipment Card.

cards.art: Earth god laughing, table vibrating, cards flying
cards.lore: The Earth Father. His laugh destroys cities. Has a goose on his head for reasons.
cards.name: GEB (THE FLOOR)
cards.power: Earthquake Laughter: Shake the table. If cards fall, they are destroyed.

cards.art: Star-covered goddess arching over ring, dropping tokens
cards.lore: The Sky Mother. Eats the sun every night. Digesting a star is heartburn central.
cards.name: NUT (THE CEILING)
cards.power: Star Fall: Drop a handful of tokens. Damage equals hits.

cards.art: Sun god in suit on yacht, lion bodyguard behind him
cards.lore: Travels the sky in a yacht. Has a lion to eat humanity because they stopped clapping.
cards.name: RA (THE CEO)
cards.power: Executive Order: Change the turn order. It's good to be the King.

cards.art: Beetle wrestler rolling a glowing sun like dung
cards.lore: Moves the sun by treating it like a ball of poop.
cards.name: KHEPRI (THE PUSHER)
cards.power: Resurrection Roll: Retrieve one card from your discard pile.

cards.art: Mummified king rising from casket, crowd cheering
cards.lore: First King. Got boxed, drowned, and chopped up. Still gets the biggest pop from the crowd.
cards.name: OSIRIS (THE ZOMBIE CHAMP)
cards.power: Undying Popularity: Cannot be eliminated. Just moves to the "Dead" pile and keeps scoring.

cards.art: Winged goddess reassembling torn card pieces
cards.lore: Queen of Magic. Conned the sun god for his password. Loyal to a fault.
cards.name: ISIS (THE FIXER)
cards.power: Gather the Pieces: Reassemble a destroyed card.

cards.art: Aardvark god grinning over fallen brother, chair in hand
cards.lore: Chaos Aardvark. Killed his brother over a chair shot. We all hate him; he loves it.
cards.name: SET (THE HEEL)
cards.power: Sandstorm Sabotage: Blind an opponent for one turn.

cards.art: Falcon-headed wrestler in gold gear squaring off against villain
cards.lore: The Falcon Heir. Fed his uncle a salad with a "secret ingredient." Issues.
cards.name: HORUS (THE GOLDEN BOY)
cards.power: Vengeance Strike: Double damage against "Heel" cards.

cards.art: Jackal-headed bouncer at velvet rope holding golden scales
cards.lore: God of Mummification. If your heart is heavy, you don't get into the club.
cards.name: ANUBIS (THE BOUNCER)
cards.power: Weighing Scale: Guess opponent's card value. If correct, eliminate it.

cards.art: Feather-crowned goddess slamming rulebook on ring, stats equalizing
cards.lore: Cosmic Order. The feather that ruins your afterlife. No cheating allowed.
cards.name: MA'AT (THE RULEBOOK)
cards.power: Balance Check: Force all stats to become equal (average).

cards.art: Croc-lion-hippo chimera devouring a card whole
cards.lore: The Devourer. Only eats the hearts of sinners. Zero calorie diet.
cards.name: AMMIT (THE DISPOSAL UNIT)
cards.power: Soul Crunch: Permanently remove a card from the game (eating it conceptually).

cards.art: Ibis-headed scribe with glowing pen rewriting a card mid-match
cards.lore: Inventor of writing. Knows the cheat codes. Gambled with the moon and won.
cards.name: THOTH (THE SCOREKEEPER)
cards.power: Wiki-Edit: Change the text of one card's Lore for the turn.

cards.art: Lion goddess with beer keg smashing all cards on table
cards.lore: The Eye of Ra. Tried to delete humanity. Stopped only by a keg of red beer.
cards.name: SEKHMET (THE DRUNK TANK)
cards.power: Rage Virus: Attack every card on the table, including your own.

cards.art: Cat goddess on pillow — one paw raised to scratch, other offering a healing potion
cards.lore: Goddess of perfume and ointment. Sekhmet on a 'good' day. Don't touch the belly.
cards.name: BASTET (THE HOUSE CAT)
cards.power: Claws & Cuddles: Heal one card or scratch one enemy.

cards.art: Bull-headed god charging through opponents, defense stats scattering
cards.lore: The War God. Represents the Pharaoh's desire to hit things very hard.
cards.name: MONTU (THE RAGING BULL)
cards.power: Trample: Ignore defense stats.

cards.art: Lion god pressing defeated cards in a wine press, perfume rising
cards.lore: God of wine and slaughter. Crushes skulls like grapes. A true artisan.
cards.name: SHEZMU (THE PRESSER)
cards.power: The Squeeze: Convert defeated cards into "Perfume" tokens.

cards.art: Crocodile god dragging a card into dark river water
cards.lore: Lord of Semen. Loves robbery. Eats tourists. A complex guy.
cards.name: SOBEK (THE TEETH)
cards.power: Ambush Drag: Pull an opponent's card into the "River" zone (discard).

cards.art: Hippo goddess tripling in size as baby card threatened behind her
cards.lore: Goddess of childbirth. Hippos kill more people than crocs. Do the math.
cards.name: TAWARET (THE HEAVY HITTER)
cards.power: Mama Bear Smash: If a "Child" card is threatened, stats triple.

cards.art: Ram-headed god at pottery wheel cloning another card in clay
cards.lore: Moulds babies out of river mud. The original 3D printer.
cards.name: KHNUM (THE POTTER)
cards.power: Clay Clone: Create a duplicate of any card in play.

cards.art: Blue-skinned deity flooding the game table, aquatic cards thriving
cards.lore: Intersex deity of the inundation. Brings the silt, brings the life, brings the wet socks.
cards.name: HAPI (THE FLOOD)
cards.power: High Water: Flood the board. All non-aquatic cards lose -2 stats.

cards.art: Dwarf lion god mid-ridiculous dance, demons fleeing in laughter
cards.lore: Protector of households. Scares demons by being ugly and loud. A true hero.
cards.name: BES (THE MASCOT)
cards.power: Distraction Dance: Opponent cannot attack this turn due to laughing.

cards.art: Sheet-ghost deity with laser eyes, ? where stats should be
cards.lore: The Smiter. He shoots with his eye. He is unseen. He is a meme.
cards.name: MEDJED (THE SHEET)
cards.power: Laser Eyes: Shoot beams from eyes. Instant hit.

cards.art: Huge baboon god charging forward mid-roar, questions dissolving around him
cards.lore: Chief of the Baboons. Eats entrails. His virility is the mast of the underworld ferry. Gross.
cards.name: BABI (THE ALPHA)
cards.power: Aggression: Attack immediately. Ask questions never.

cards.art: Scorpion goddess choosing between syringe and stinger
cards.lore: She who tightens the throat. Doctors love her. Scorpions are just misunderstood land-lobsters.
cards.name: SERKET (THE STINGER)
cards.power: Venom Heal: Poison enemies or cure allies.

cards.art: Gilded boat sailing through starfield, dark serpent coiling below
cards.lore: Millions of years, zero maintenance. Defense against the dark snake.
cards.name: THE SOLAR BARQUE (TOUR BUS)
cards.power: Night Travel: Skip the opponent's turn.

cards.art: Golden scales over wrestling ring with hippo waiting below
cards.lore: No calibration needed. If you tilt it, the hippo eats you.
cards.name: THE SCALES OF JUSTICE (THE REF'S TOOL)
cards.power: Judgment: Compare stats. Lower stat is eliminated.

cards.art: Crossed crook and flail as WWE-style title belts, glowing
cards.lore: Shepherd the people, beat the grain. The duality of management.
cards.name: THE CROOK & FLAIL (TITLE BELTS)
cards.power: Command: Control an opponent's card for one turn.

cards.art: Glowing eye firing solar beam into chaos cards
cards.lore: Remote-controlled drone strike of the ancient world.
cards.name: THE EYE OF RA (HEAT RAY)
cards.power: Solar Flare: Deal 10 damage to all "Chaos" type cards.

cards.art: Leopard-skinned goddess with measuring stick peering into deck future
cards.lore: She notches your lifespan on a stick. Invented math. Wearing a skin of her own species? Punk.
cards.name: SESHAT (THE ARCHITECT)
cards.power: Blueprint: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck.

cards.art: Mummified god whispering a card name, it dissolving from opponent's hand
cards.lore: Thought the world into existence. The ultimate introvert creation myth.
cards.name: PTAH (THE CREATOR)
cards.power: Spoken Reality: Name a card. If opponent has it, they discard it.

cards.art: Human in hard hat ascending pyramid stairs to god-level boardroom
cards.lore: Was a mortal, built a pyramid, got promoted to God. The corporate ladder works.
cards.name: IMHOTEP (THE ASCENDED FAN)
cards.power: Polymath: Can use the Power of any other "Manager" card.

cards.art: Spider-armed goddess rearranging opponent's hand cards like threads on a loom
cards.lore: The terrifying one. Wove the universe. Mothers crocodiles. Do not ask her to knit you a sweater.
cards.name: NEITH (THE WEAVER)
cards.power: Fate Weave: Rearrange the order of any player's hand.

cards.art: Glitching serpent eating the game table itself, error codes everywhere
cards.lore: The World Encircler. Ra's umbilical cord gone wrong. Pray AGAINST him.
cards.name: APEP (THE GLITCH)
cards.power: System Crash: End the game. Nobody wins unless Ra is in play.

cards.art: Antelope-griffin hybrid leaping at confused tourists in desert
cards.lore: Desert dweller. A visual non-sequitur designed to scare tourists.
cards.name: THE AKHEKH (THE GRIFFIN-ISH)
cards.power: Desert Terror: Apply "Fear" status to opponent.

cards.art: 7 scorpions in formation bodyguard-style, one mid-sting at a bourgeois card
cards.lore: Isis's bodyguards. They stung a rich lady's son because she was rude. Class warfare.
cards.name: SEVEN SCORPIONS (THE POSSE)
cards.power: Swarm: 7 small attacks instead of 1 big one.

cards.art: Red storm cloud rolling over ring, accuracy numbers dissolving
cards.lore: The angry breath of Set. Red is the color of bad things in the desert.
cards.name: THE RED CLOUD (STORM FRONT)
cards.power: Blindness: All accuracy stats reduced to zero.

cards.art: White vulture goddess with white crown, defense aura when paired
cards.lore: Patron of Upper Egypt. Vultures are good mothers. It's a cultural thing.
cards.name: NEKHBET (SOUTH)
cards.power: White Crown: +5 Defense if played with Wadjet.

cards.art: Cobra goddess with red crown, attack flames when paired with Nekhbet
cards.lore: Patron of Lower Egypt. Fire-spitting snake. Put her on your forehead for protection.
cards.name: WADJET (NORTH)
cards.power: Red Crown: +5 Attack if played with Nekhbet.

cards.art: Fate deity writing outcome in ledger before dice hit table
cards.lore: The concept of Fate. You can't fight the booking committee.
cards.name: SHAI (DESTINY)
cards.power: The Script: Decide the outcome of a dice roll before rolling.

cards.art: Snake-nursing harvest goddess with coins growing from the ground
cards.lore: Goddess of the harvest and nursing. Snakes and milk. Don't think about it too hard.
cards.name: RENENUTET (THE NURSE)
cards.power: Harvest Gold: Gain resources each turn.

cards.art: Dark tunnel with 12 gates, dead cards warming up backstage
cards.lore: The Underworld. Dangerous, full of snakes, and you have to pass 12 gates to leave.
cards.name: THE DUAT (BACKSTAGE AREA)

cards.art: Golden reed fields with lounging gods, no tax forms in sight
cards.lore: Aaru. The goal. It's just like Earth but you don't have to pay taxes.
cards.name: THE FIELD OF REEDS (VIP LOUNGE)

cards.art: Obelisk-ringed city with solar gods in boardroom suits
cards.lore: City of the Sun. Where the Ennead holds their board meetings.
cards.name: HELIOPOLIS (THE MAIN STAGE)

cards.art: First island rising from chaos waters with title belt on the peak
cards.lore: The first solid ground. Everything starts here. King of the Hill rules apply.
cards.name: THE PRIMEVAL MOUND (THE RING MAT)

cards.art: Set at salad bar with golden disk materializing on head
cards.lore: Set ate salad with Horus's... dressing. A gold disk appeared on his head. Awkward.
cards.name: THE LETTUCE INCIDENT

cards.art: Lioness goddess passed out in red beer field, strongest fighter card slumping
cards.lore: She thought it was blood. It was dyed beer. The original hangover.
cards.name: THE RED BEER TRICK

cards.art: Isis with 13 pieces, golden prosthetic glowing, CENSORED fish card nearby
cards.lore: Isis found 13 pieces of Osiris. The fish ate the 14th. Had to make a gold replacement.
cards.name: THE MISSING PIECE

cards.art: Thoth at gambling table winning days from calendar god
cards.lore: Nut couldn't give birth in the 360 day year. Thoth won 5 extra days gambling. Loophole!
cards.name: THE EXTRA 5 DAYS
